Bill.BriefDescription: Directing the utilities and transportation commission to study peak and off-peak electric rates.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to peak and offpeak electric rates; and creatinga new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The utilities and transportation commissionshall study and make recommendations on developing optional time of useelectric rates that reflect the costs of serving customers at differenttime periods, including peak and offpeak periods. The utilities andtransportation commission shall submit a report of its findings andrecommendations to the appropriate committees of the legislature byJanuary 1, 2012.
